--- text
alpha beta| gamma

delta epsilon zeta
--- keys
Down Down
--- expect
alpha beta gamma

delta epsi|lon zeta
--- note
The goal column is a remembered x, and it must survive a line too short to
hold it. Column 10 down onto the empty middle line clamps to column 0, its
only column; the second Down must restore column 10 on the long line below,
landing before the 'l' of "epsilon". Carrying column 0 forward instead is the
"Down doesn't go where I aimed" bug. This is fixture 05 with a zero-length
intermediate line rather than a two-character one: the goal session must not
re-measure the caret on the empty line.
